groups.contract: EZoneDetector inherits OrderAuditEngineMixin. Constructor takes six required inputs direction, trend_reactions, opposite_reactions, s_zones, opposite_resets, chronology. Remaining positional-or-keyword arguments: start_index=0; end_index=None; direct_geometry_finder=None (geometry direction, two integer bounds, datetime -> object or None); blocked_order_first_times=None; e_parent_order_first_exceptions=empty frozenset of datetime pairs; initial_order_audit=None; sequence_resets=None; sequence_priority=None (kind/family -> int, mandatory non-None at runtime); invalid_s_root_identities=None; order_b_legs=empty tuple; live_continuation=None; live_scope=empty tuple. Return annotation None; implicit return after successful init. Immutable defaults formed at definition; future annotations postponed, type union AST sites are not price arithmetic or runtime dispatch. No super constructor call in body. No local enforcement of annotation types.

First evaluate membership in the two allowed direction strings, case-sensitive, without normalization; nonmember raises ValueError with explicit message before assignments. An unhashable object may raise TypeError during membership rather than that ValueError. Store direction, resolve policy_for(direction), then store policy; only afterward reject sequence_priority is None with ValueError. Non-None falsey or noncallable resolver is retained, no invocation or callable check here. Provider direction_policy returns shared frozen BULLISH or BEARISH policy; low/high extremes, opposite high/low, first RED/GREEN and context GREEN/RED respectively. Price comparisons are not performed by constructor.

Make fresh set from invalid_s_root_identities if truthy, otherwise a fresh empty set. Shallow set conversion only: no int conversion, timestamp normalization or structural validation of identity members. Allocate independent empty accepted E identity set. Evaluate sequence_resets truthiness, supply original or fresh empty dict to property setter E10 before assigning market fields. Setter copies dict, sorts keys and conditionally clears four existing caches in order; no alias to supplied reset mapping. This is a separate owner procedure; may mutate before later failure, especially explicit reinitialization. Call chronology.opposite_direction(direction) then store result and chronology reference. Native provider resolves mirror through policy; custom chronology output not locally revalidated. Setter can fail before chronology is assigned.

Shallow materialization of trend then opposite reaction sequences into fresh lists, preserving iteration order and element references, no sorting. Stable S sort by (required source_time attribute, int(required source_index attribute)), ascending, no dedup or object field mutation. Key evaluation in input iteration order; int conversion is only sort key, not stored replacement index. Stable opposite reset sort by bound _reset_time, which delegates to stored chronology.reset_time. Native provider may read/write reset-time cache; exact second string preferred, then display string, then timestamp; malformed attributes or incomparable sort keys propagate. Source collections not sorted in place; elements remain shared. No explicit validation of chronological alignment or identity uniqueness.

Store aliases in order: chronology.candles -> candles, seconds -> lower, second_times -> lower_times, lower_index -> lower_index, timeframe -> timeframe, times -> times. No copy, sort, price conversion or recomputation. Native MarketChronology retains candle and lower sequences, derives or aliases times from indexes, creates timedelta and retains selected index, exposes per-chronology E-extreme cache. Native invariants and immutability convention remain conditional when external chronology is supplied.

Convert start_index via int, no explicit clamp. Default end only on identity None: len(candles)-1 (inclusive); otherwise int(end_index), so explicit zero is valid. Store range_start from times[start_index], range_end from times[end_index]+timeframe; intended interval [range_start,range_end) with whole end main candle included. No local nonempty, 0<=start<=end<len, times/candles equality, or timeframe validation. Native negative indexing may succeed and reversed bounds can be stored, while out-of-range or failed conversions/addition raise; no claim malformed cases reachable through native caller. No rounding of prices.

Initialize shared query to None. Read optional chronology.main_range_index with None default; only if identity None evaluate timeframe.total_seconds()==1 and use lower_index. Existing falsey non-None main index suppresses fallback. Fallback lookup and timeframe evaluation occur even with a non-None live continuation; no assumption one-second index actually owns main candles. No data loaded from RAW in this review.

Shared-query selection only when live_continuation is None, then getattr(market_index,'candles',None) is self.candles (identity, not value equality); short circuit skips candidate candles access in live mode. Choose range_minimum for bullish else range_maximum; getattr default None, store retrieved value without callable/truthiness test. Nonlive and shared query is None invokes E15 _initialize_main_extremes. Any non-None live value, even falsey, bypasses both query selection and sparse initialization. Native shared range query uses half-open bounds and earliest position for ties; E23 later converts inclusive end to end+1 and may lazily initialize sparse on invalid shared-query range. Native E15 reuses chronology cache by direction or builds Decimal extrema, integer candle codes and earliest-tie sparse table; does not execute here when shared query non-None. Noncallable non-None query fails only on later invocation; no local validation of index size or callable geometry equivalence.

Store direct_geometry_finder as supplied, no local callable test. blocked_order_first_times or fresh empty set: truthy original retained by reference, falsey replaced. Store e_parent_order_first_exceptions directly, including explicit None or other malformed type (no validation). initial_order_audit or fresh empty dict: truthy original retained, falsey replaced. Distinct from authoritative mutable order_audit initialized later. Tuple-materialize order_b_legs preserving input iteration order and element references; no sorting, normalization or registration at this step. Store live_continuation and live_scope directly; no advance, dirty identity check or scope conversion. Non-None continuation is a dispatch condition, not proof bridge supplies it.

Call inherited _initialize_order_audit only after all preceding market, bounds, geometry, ledger, legs and live fields set. Mixin creates fresh current order_audit and query caches/chronological indexes, obtains reaction first/confirmation times, stable trend confirmation order, reset grouping, last-wins opposite first-index map and first-wins physical identity position map. Native confirmation and reset queries may mutate chronology caches. After successful initializer only, create fresh visual_lifecycle_starts set, consumed-S evidence list and last-candidate list in order. No return value on success. No broad catch, cleanup, transaction or rollback: earlier object/chronology changes may remain if later sort/index/provider/allocation fails. Constructor does not accept or reconcile E zones, register legs, or finalize physical Orders. No new cross-owner acceptance.
